```{r}
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
# Scan data preprocessing (raw scan.csv -> filtered, scan-numbered dataset)
# Replaces reading the static scans_for_bison.csv directly, so this
# pipeline always rebuilds from the current raw scan data when re-run.
# ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════

library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)

# ── Step 1: load raw scans, clean dates and blank individuals ──────────
scans_raw<- read.csv(
  "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/scans/scan.csv",
  header = TRUE, sep = ",", stringsAsFactors = FALSE, check.names = FALSE
)

scans_raw$date <- as.Date(scans_raw$date)
scans_raw<- scans_raw%>% filter(!is.na(date))
scans_raw$year <- year(scans_raw$date)

scans_raw<- scans_raw%>%
  filter(!is.na(idindividual1), idindividual1 != "")

# Normalize ID casing/whitespace - matches emigrants_full$Code convention
scans_raw$idindividual1 <- tolower(trimws(as.character(scans_raw$idindividual1)))

# Also normalize any proximity-partner columns used downstream
prox_cols <- c("ind1m", "indarmlength", "ind2m", "ind5m", "ind10m")
for (col in prox_cols) {
  if (col %in% names(scans_raw)) {
    scans_raw[[col]] <- tolower(trimws(as.character(scans_raw[[col]])))
  }
}

# ── Step 2: within a day, keep only scans of the same individual at
# least 20 minutes apart ────────────────────────────────────────────────
filter_independent_scans <- function(data, min_interval_minutes = 20) {
  data <- data %>%
    mutate(
      time_minutes = hour(hms(time)) * 60 + minute(hms(time)),
      row_id = row_number()
    ) %>%
    arrange(date, idindividual1, time_minutes)

  data <- data %>%
    group_by(date, idindividual1) %>%
    mutate(
      time_diff = c(Inf, diff(time_minutes)),
      keep = cumsum(time_diff >= min_interval_minutes | time_diff == Inf) >
             lag(cumsum(time_diff >= min_interval_minutes | time_diff == Inf), default = 0)
    ) %>%
    filter(keep) %>%
    dplyr::select(-time_minutes, -row_id, -time_diff, -keep) %>%
    ungroup()

  data
}

scans_ivp_filtered <- filter_independent_scans(scans_raw, min_interval_minutes = 20)

write.csv(scans_ivp_filtered,
          "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/scans/scans_ivp_20minfiltered.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── Step 3: assign scan numbers / scan IDs ──────────────────────────────
add_scan_numbers <- function(scan_filtered) {

  scan_filtered$datetime <- as.POSIXct(paste(scan_filtered$date, scan_filtered$time),
                                        format = "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")
  scan_filtered <- scan_filtered[order(scan_filtered$group, scan_filtered$date, scan_filtered$datetime), ]

  scan_filtered$scan_number <- NA
  scan_filtered$scan_id <- NA

  unique_combinations <- unique(scan_filtered[, c("group", "date")])

  for (i in 1:nrow(unique_combinations)) {
    current_group <- unique_combinations$group[i]
    current_date  <- unique_combinations$date[i]

    subset_indices <- which(scan_filtered$group == current_group & scan_filtered$date == current_date)
    subset_data <- scan_filtered[subset_indices, ]

    current_scan <- 1
    subset_data$scan_number[1] <- current_scan
    last_observation_time <- subset_data$datetime[1]
    individuals_in_current_scan <- subset_data$idindividual1[1]

    if (nrow(subset_data) > 1) {
      for (j in 2:nrow(subset_data)) {

        time_diff <- as.numeric(difftime(subset_data$datetime[j], last_observation_time, units = "mins"))
        current_individual <- subset_data$idindividual1[j]

        start_new_scan <- FALSE
        if (time_diff > 15) start_new_scan <- TRUE
        if (current_individual %in% individuals_in_current_scan) start_new_scan <- TRUE

        if (start_new_scan) {
          current_scan <- current_scan + 1
          individuals_in_current_scan <- current_individual
        } else {
          individuals_in_current_scan <- c(individuals_in_current_scan, current_individual)
        }

        last_observation_time <- subset_data$datetime[j]
        subset_data$scan_number[j] <- current_scan
      }
    }

    subset_data$scan_id <- paste0(subset_data$scan_number, "_", subset_data$date, "_", subset_data$group)

    scan_filtered[subset_indices, "scan_number"] <- subset_data$scan_number
    scan_filtered[subset_indices, "scan_id"] <- subset_data$scan_id
  }

  cat("Scan numbering complete:\n")
  cat("Total observations:", nrow(scan_filtered), "\n")
  cat("Total unique scan IDs:", length(unique(scan_filtered$scan_id)), "\n")

  scan_filtered
}

scans_ivp_filtered <- add_scan_numbers(scans_ivp_filtered)

write.csv(scans_ivp_filtered,
          "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/scans/scanswithid_ivp_20minfiltered.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

# ── Step 4: this is now the `scans` object used by the rest of the script ──
scans <- scans_ivp_filtered
group_abbreviations <- c("Baie Dankie" = "BD", "Noha" = "NH", "Ankhase" = "AK",
                          "Kubu" = "KB", "Lemon Tree" = "LT", "Crossing" = "CR",
                          "IFamily" = "IF")

scans$group_Abbreviation <- group_abbreviations[scans$group]

write.csv(scans,
          "/Users/alba/Library/Mobile Documents/com~apple~CloudDocs/Postdoc_UNIL/Vervet_projects/IVP_data/scans/scans_for_bison.csv",
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("\nFinal scans object (saved as scans_for_bison.csv): ", nrow(scans), "rows,",
    length(unique(scans$scan_id)), "unique scan IDs\n")
```
SCANS_FOR_BISON.CSV IS THE SAME AS THE scanswithid_ivp_20minfiltered.CSV

# Scan selection logic

The function `extract_proximity_pairs()` (sourced from
`scan_extraction_1mandarm.R`) selects proximity interactions using a
year-dependent hierarchy:

**Before 2022:**

1. If `ind1m` is filled → use it and STOP
2. If `ind1m` empty → check if `distancenna = "1m"` or `distancennj = "1m"`
   - If `distancenna = "1m"` → use `nnadult`
   - If `distancennj = "1m"` → use `nnjuvenile`
3. Only if ALL three are empty: check `indarmlength`, then `distancenna = "Arm length"` or `distancennj = "Arm length"`

**From 2022 onwards:** Same hierarchy but flipped — arm length is prioritised first:

1. If `indarmlength` is filled → use it and STOP
2. If `indarmlength` empty → check `distancenna = "Arm length"` or `distancennj = "Arm length"`
3. Only if all arm length sources are empty → check `ind1m` and 1m distances

# Bayesian network metric estimation

## Method

For each immigrant male, we extract all group scans collected between his
immigration date and 365 days post-immigration. We build a proximity network
including all group members observed during that period.

Edge weights are estimated using conjugate Bayesian inference. For each dyad,
the posterior edge weight is sampled from:

$$\text{Beta}(0.1 + \text{count}, \; 0.1 + \text{duration} - \text{count})$$

where `count` is the number of scans in which both individuals were observed
in proximity (co-occurrence scans) and `duration` is the SRI denominator
(`scans_node_1 + scans_node_2 - count`). The Beta(0.1, 0.1) prior is weakly
informative and matches the prior used in bisonR's `binary_conjugate` model.

We draw 1000 posterior network instantiations and compute node-level metrics
on each, yielding posterior distributions for each metric.

## Metrics

- **Degree**: number of distinct individuals the focal male was observed in
  proximity with. Estimated with uncertainty from the Bayesian edge weight model.

- **Strength**: sum of all Bayesian edge weights connecting the focal male to
  his associates. Reflects both number of associates and strength of
  association with each.

- **Strength association** (classic): frequentist counterpart — sum of SRI
  values across all dyads involving the focal male. Reported as a robustness
  check without uncertainty.

- **Eigenvector centrality**: measures the focal male's influence by accounting
  for how well-connected his associates are. Computed from the Bayesian
  posterior on each network draw.

Full posterior draws (1000 per male per metric) are saved as `.rds` files for
use in downstream BISoN-style analyses (e.g., propagating uncertainty through
SEM models). It is called prox_posteriors.rds

A file called network_mets_proximity_bayes.csv is saved where the prox_results$summaries are stored.

# Column descriptions

| Column | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| `Code` | Individual male's ID code |
| `group` | Immigration group (`ImmigrationGp1`) |
| `start_date` | Date of immigration |
| `end_date` | Immigration date + 365 days |
| `degree_mean` | Mean number of non-zero edges across 1000 posterior draws |
| `degree_lower` / `degree_upper` | 95% credible interval (2.5th–97.5th percentiles) |
| `strength_mean` | Mean sum of edge weights across 1000 posterior draws |
| `strength_lower` / `strength_upper` | 95% credible interval |
| `strength_assoc` | Classic SRI-based strength (point estimate, no uncertainty) |
| `eigenvector_mean` | Mean eigenvector centrality across 1000 posterior draws |
| `eigenvector_lower` / `eigenvector_upper` | 95% credible interval |
| `n_dyads` | Total number of dyads in the network |
| `n_scans` | Number of scans in which this male was observed |

# Summary

```{r summary}
cat("Males with proximity metrics:", nrow(network_proximity_bayes), "\n\n") 

summary(network_proximity_bayes %>%
  select(degree_mean, strength_mean, strength_assoc, n_scans))
```

#Check of whether metrics calculated in different years are comparable.
```{r}
overlap_years <- 2016:2021

scans_overlap <- scans %>%
  mutate(date = as.Date(date)) %>%
  filter(!is.na(date), lubridate::year(date) %in% overlap_years)

# ── Force single-distance extraction (mirrors extract_proximity_pairs logic) ──
extract_1m_only <- function(scan_data) {
  scan_data %>%
    mutate(interaction_partner = case_when(
      !is.na(ind1m) & ind1m != ""  ~ ind1m,
      distancenna == "1m"           ~ nnadult,
      distancennj == "1m"           ~ nnjuvenile,
      TRUE                          ~ NA_character_
    ))
}

extract_arm_only <- function(scan_data) {
  scan_data %>%
    mutate(interaction_partner = case_when(
      !is.na(indarmlength) & indarmlength != "" ~ indarmlength,
      distancenna == "Arm length"                 ~ nnadult,
      distancennj == "Arm length"                 ~ nnjuvenile,
      TRUE                                        ~ NA_character_
    ))
}

prox_1m  <- extract_1m_only(scans_overlap)
prox_arm <- extract_arm_only(scans_overlap)

#Build a simple SRI-based dyadic network + node metrics for each distance type
build_network_metrics <- function(scan_subset) {
  
  scan_subset <- scan_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(idindividual1) & idindividual1 != "")
  
  from_focal <- scan_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(idindividual1) & idindividual1 != "") %>%
    distinct(idindividual1, scan_id) %>%
    rename(individual = idindividual1)
  
  from_partner <- scan_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(interaction_partner) & interaction_partner != "") %>%
    distinct(interaction_partner, scan_id) %>%
    rename(individual = interaction_partner)
  
  individual_scan_counts <- bind_rows(from_focal, from_partner) %>%
    distinct() %>%
    group_by(individual) %>%
    summarise(scans_sampled = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop")
  
  dyadic_data <- scan_subset %>%
    filter(!is.na(interaction_partner) & interaction_partner != "") %>%
    mutate(
      node_1 = pmin(idindividual1, interaction_partner),
      node_2 = pmax(idindividual1, interaction_partner)
    ) %>%
    filter(node_1 != node_2) %>%
    group_by(node_1, node_2) %>%
    summarise(event = n_distinct(scan_id), .groups = "drop") %>%
    left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_1" = "individual")) %>%
    rename(scans_node_1 = scans_sampled) %>%
    left_join(individual_scan_counts, by = c("node_2" = "individual")) %>%
    rename(scans_node_2 = scans_sampled) %>%
    mutate(
      duration = scans_node_1 + scans_node_2 - event,
      sri      = event / duration
    )
  
  g <- igraph::graph_from_data_frame(
    dyadic_data %>% dplyr::select(node_1, node_2, weight = sri),
    directed = FALSE
  )
  
  tibble(
    id       = igraph::V(g)$name,
    degree   = igraph::degree(g),
    strength = igraph::strength(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight),
    eigen    = igraph::eigen_centrality(g, weights = igraph::E(g)$weight)$vector
  )
}
metrics_1m  <- build_network_metrics(prox_1m)  %>% rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_1m"),  -id)
metrics_arm <- build_network_metrics(prox_arm) %>% rename_with(~paste0(.x, "_arm"), -id)

#Restrict to individuals with metrics in both, then correlate:

both_ids <- intersect(metrics_1m$id, metrics_arm$id)
length(both_ids)

comparison_full <- metrics_1m %>%
  filter(id %in% both_ids) %>%
  left_join(metrics_arm, by = "id")

# full comparison (strongest evidence for reviewers)
cor.test(comparison_full$degree_1m,   comparison_full$degree_arm,   method = "spearman")
cor.test(comparison_full$strength_1m, comparison_full$strength_arm, method = "spearman") #rho= 0.76

ggplot(comparison_full, aes(x = strength_1m, y = strength_arm)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6) +
  geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, color = "steelblue") +
  labs(x = "Strength (1m-based network)", y = "Strength (arm-based network)",
       title = "1m vs arm-length strength, 2016-2021 overlap") +
  theme_minimal()
```
